thanks.text: Thank you Ada for organising everything so well. I felt welcome from the first day.
Thank you Tunde for the photos of my dresses. I use them to sell on Instagram.
Thank you Chinedu for setting up our sewing machines every morning.
Thank you Musa for driving us from Ikorodu every day.
Thank you Blessing for teaching me to sew with patience. I was so scared at first.
Thank you Yemi for helping me fill the form. I cannot read well yet.
Thank you Fatima for the bead-making class. You made it so joyful.
Thank you Segun for keeping us safe going home in the evening.
Thank you Amaka for the delicious jollof every afternoon!
Thank you David for carrying all the fabric boxes for us.
Thank you Rukayat for translating into Yoruba. I understood everything.
Thank you Kelechi for filming my story. My children watched it with pride.
Thank you Dangote Foundation for the 10 sewing machines. I now sew school uniforms for my whole street.
Thank you Chioma for paying my hairdressing kit. I did my first paid braids yesterday!
To the kind donor: thank you for my training fees. I could never have paid them alone.
Thank you Femi for the baking oven. I sell bread every morning before church.
Thank you Aisha for the bead-making starter kit. My first necklace sold in one day!
Thank you Bisi for my transport money. I came every day without missing a class.
Thank you John for the notebook and pens. I wrote down every recipe.
Thank you Ngozi for the childcare corner. My baby was safe while I learnt.
Thank you Emeka for the fabric. I made my first dress for my daughter.
To whoever paid for lunch: thank you, we learnt better with full stomachs.
Thank you Halima for the soap-making materials. My shop shelf is full now.
Thank you Kunle for my certificate. I framed it in my shop.
Thank you Grace for the scissors and measuring tape. They are my treasures.
Thank you Ibrahim for the small business grant. I bought my first stock of fabric.
Thank you Funke for the phone training. I now take orders on WhatsApp.
Thank you Uche for the snacks for our children. They played while we worked.
Thank you Zainab for the hair dryer. My clients don't wait anymore.
To the kind donor: thank you for the generator fuel. We sewed even when NEPA took light.
Thank you Tolu for the apron and gloves. I feel like a real baker.
Thank you Patience. You were trained here last year and now you helped me. I will do the same.
